oem.meta_title: OEM & ODM Wooden Kitchenware Manufacturing — DEVIAS HOME Vietnam
oem.meta_desc: Custom wooden kitchenware OEM & ODM from Vietnam. Cutting boards, bowls, trays and utensils with private label, FSC-certified materials, and food-safe finishes.
oem.sub: We manufacture wooden kitchenware to your exact specifications — from custom design and private labeling to full OEM/ODM production runs for global retail.
oem.s1_p: Bring your own design and we handle the rest. Supply your specifications, artwork and packaging brief — we source materials, manufacture, and QC to your standard.
oem.s2_p: Our in-house design team develops new products from your brief to production-ready samples. You own the tooling; we deliver your vision on time.
oem.s3_p: Select from our proven product range, add your logo and custom packaging. Minimum MOQ from 500 units per SKU with short lead times.
oem.moq_ship_v: FCL / LCL · FOB Ho Chi Minh City
oem.why1_p: Lower production costs than China without sacrificing quality — ideal for scaling retail ranges.
oem.why2_p: Dedicated ODM team handling 3D modeling, prototyping and pre-production samples.
oem.why3_p: FSC wood traceability, food-safety test reports, and full export documentation prepared for you.
oem.why4_p: Existing supply relationships with major Korean supermarket chains — we understand the standards.
oem.cert4: Certificate of Origin (CO) for all shipments
oem.cta2_h: Ready to start your OEM project?
oem.cta2_p: Share your product brief or sketch — our export team responds within 24 hours with a tailored proposal.

about.meta_title: About DEVIAS HOME — Vietnamese Wooden Kitchenware Manufacturer
about.meta_desc: DEVIAS HOME is a Vietnamese B2B manufacturer of food-safe wooden kitchenware, exporting OEM/ODM to Korea, Europe and global retail markets.
about.sub: DEVIAS HOME is a Vietnamese manufacturer of premium wooden kitchenware, trusted by retail chains across Korea and beyond.
about.mission_p: To be the most reliable wooden kitchenware manufacturing partner for global importers — combining Vietnamese craftsmanship, international certifications, and responsive export service.
about.factory_p: Located in Nghe An Province — Vietnam's heartland of hardwood craftsmanship — our facility operates dedicated woodworking, finishing, quality control and export packaging lines. We work with FSC-certified acacia and rubber wood sourced from sustainable Vietnamese forests.
about.korea_p: DEVIAS HOME has been a trusted manufacturing partner for major Korean supermarket chains and home goods retailers. Our products consistently meet HACCP food-safety requirements and the strict quality expectations of the Korean retail market.
about.why1_p: Vietnam is the world's 2nd-largest furniture and wood products exporter, with Nghe An Province offering abundant FSC-certified hardwoods and skilled craftspeople.
about.why2_p: Lower labor and material costs than China, without compromising on finish quality or food-safety compliance.
about.why3_p: Dedicated account managers who understand Korean import requirements, HACCP standards, and global retail compliance.
about.why4_p: From 500-unit private-label runs to full custom ODM design — we scale with your business.
about.cta_p: Send us your product specifications or request a catalog — our export team replies within 24 hours.
